title: Fit Tuber Lied: The Truth About Ayurveda & Sexual Health
tags: fit tuber ayurveda and sexual health
description:
Ayurveda is often praised as a treasure of ancient wisdom. But when you dig into the original texts — Caraka Samhita, Susrutha Samhita, and Ashtanga Hrudaya — you uncover ideas about sex and reproduction that are unscientific, male-centric, and often outright disturbing. From calling women “objects” and prescribing submission, to recommending sex with underage girls for “strength,” these texts reveal a deeply misogynistic worldview that should have no place in a modern, secular society.

In this episode of Pale Blue Thoughts, we critically examine Fit Tuber’s viral video on Ayurveda and a “healthy sex life.” He cherry-picks quotes to make Ayurveda sound progressive and scientifically valid. But when we check the same books he cites, the reality is shocking. We expose passages endorsing child sex, bizarre aphrodisiac recipes involving crocodile semen and animal testicles, menstrual taboos, and laughable claims linking sex suppression to diabetes and obesity
This video highlights how pseudoscience thrives when influencers promote half-truths while ignoring the darker side of tradition. By exposing the actual words of the Ayurvedic texts, we show how dangerous blind faith in “ancient wisdom” can be for gender equality, scientific thinking, and public health. Modern science and medicine are far ahead of such outdated, harmful notions.

If you’ve searched for Ayurveda sex life debunked, Fit Tuber Ayurveda exposed, Caraka Samhita myths, Ashtanga Hrudaya sex rules, Susrutha Samhita debunked, Ayurveda pseudoscience, this video gives you the rational perspective.

Don’t forget to subscribe, like, comment, and share — hype this video so it reaches more people and sparks better conversations about science and skepticism.
